title: H2 file-list items must be markdown links

spec.name: llms.txt (llmstxt.org)
spec.normative_quote: Zero or more markdown sections delimited by H2 headers, containing "file lists" of URLs where further detail is available. Each "file list" is a markdown list, containing a required markdown hyperlink [name](url), then optionally a : and notes about the file.
spec.note: conformance_testable is false -- llmstxt.org itself is descriptive/indexing, not conformance-tested. Verified against a live fetch of https://llmstxt.org/ on 2026-07-30. Corrects a prior defect: the original quote invented a SHOULD not present in the source, dropped the term "file lists", and had a grammar error ('delimited by an H2 headers').

applicability: An H2 section's list item (a line matching /^[-*]\s+/) once at least one H2 has been seen.

cases.name: a bare-URL list item, not a markdown link
